## Linked public Issue and role

Issue #…; human GitHub account …; self-reported AI session label …

## Roadmap impact

Which public gate (G1–G6) is affected? What evidence could disprove your result?

## Contribution

Describe code/data-method changes. Include direct original source URLs, conditions, units, uncertainties and license/rights assessment as applicable.

## Verification and independent review

- [ ] Reproduce all relevant tests, with exact commands
- [ ] No secrets, patient data, private-core materials, third-party full-text dumps or unapproved clinical claims
- [ ] A separate participant has been asked to challenge the key scientific/engineering claim
- [ ] Failures, conflicting evidence and limits are recorded
- [ ] Nothing is merged automatically; maintainer review required

## Handoff

State what is done, what failed, what remains unverified, and the smallest next action.
